verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents OAuth 2.0 client registration, authorization requests, and access/refresh token generation, with a scopes catalog that gates access per module. This lets a user issue an agent credential limited to only the modules it needs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of finer-grained read-vs-write scope granularity, agent- or MCP-specific credential scoping and revocation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
